prompt: Fix the timezone handling bug in src/parser.py so parse_ts(s) correctly handles ISO-8601 timestamps that carry a UTC offset. Today parse_ts strips the offset without normalizing: parse_ts("2024-01-01T12:00:00+02:00") returns 2024-01-01T12:00:00 instead of the correct UTC wall time 2024-01-01T10:00:00. The function must always return a naive UTC datetime: offset timestamps must be normalized to UTC (then returned as naive), naive timestamps like "2024-01-01T10:00:00" must keep working unchanged, and unparseable input must still raise ValueError. Do not change the public signature or the function name. The verification script tests/run.sh must exit 0.
